Card Q&A.a: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks"  to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have [Tai Kamiya] or a Tamer with the [ADVENTURE] trait, give 1 of your opponent's Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Agumon] in name or w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2
